items.title: Banning Open Source AI Would Be A Mistake
items.summary: This post was originally an op-ed co-authored with of Interconnected for a general, non-technical audience. The gatekeepers — the many media outlets we pitched it to — passed on publishing it. Luckily, we have our own platforms to get the message out.
